meta-runner.name: Gemini Prompt
meta-runner.description: Run an AI prompt using Gemini

parameters.param:
#!/bin/bash set -e
git config user.name "Gemini CLI" git config user.email "gemini@smart-pricer.com"
# enable Gemini API key export GEMINI_API_KEY='%GEMINI_API_KEY%'
# working directory if [ ! -z "%work_dir%" ]; then echo "Working Directory: %work_dir%" cd "%work_dir%" fi
# run the prompt pipx run --spec git+https://github.com/smartpricer/antigravity-teamcity.git antigravity-teamcity << 'END_OF_PROMPT' %prompt% END_OF_PROMPT
